observations: Do not use ambiguous short CLI flags in exclusion, authorization, or safety predicates; pin the explicit long option whose behavior is required.
Regression tests for subprocess-backed exclusion logic must assert the real stdout against a known-positive prior identifier, not only mock the command or test an empty corpus.

When a frozen held-out event reveals a post-reveal selection-predicate defect, preserve the chronology and publish a bounded FAIL; do not repair the event by retrying, replacing the task, or reusing the revealed answer.
